[[Sub-Predor]] [[Ceh'let]] commanded a '''flagship''' from which she oversaw the [[Battle of Shikaakwa|attack]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shikaakwa]] in [[25,792 BBY]]. A [[Rakatan ship]] shaped like the [[Star Forge]] with three prongs, the ship suffered damage during the battle thanks to [[Deathstalker-class fighter|''Deathstalker''-class fighters]].<ref name="War 1" />
